title: Field identity catalog
description: Durable names for taxpayer-facing boxes. The identity id is not a quantised bbox and not an HTML cell id. Stage 3 will join these records to official serialized_key values; this schema is not that join.

id.description: Durable identity. Never recycled. Never derived from a bbox or from p1cN.

source_printed_box_pt.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, top-left origin, from the pinned PDF / stage-1 emission of that artwork. Artwork identity. After a Stage 2 reflow the matcher uses the emitted box whose center still sits in this rectangle.

official_field_key.description: Harvested HTA field_key when one exists in this checkout. Null only with a non-empty official_field_key_gap.

official_field_key_gap.description: Empty when official_field_key is set. Otherwise an honest gap, never a blank.

html_id_hint.description: Current batch cell id. Non-authoritative. A mismatch against a unique center hit is html_id_hint_stale, a schema change, not a new identity.

correction_id.description: Stage 2 ledger id when this subject is also a correction. Null if identity-only.
